description_en: Deletes a specified DataAgent. After the deletion, the name is released and can be reused to create a new DataAgent
description_zh: 删除指定的 DataAgent。删除后该名称被释放，可以用同一个名称重新创建
name: DeleteDataAgent

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent to delete, which is passed in the request path. If the DataAgent does not exist, a 404 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的 DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入。DataAgent 不存在时返回 404
parameters.name: name

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent to delete, which is passed in the request path. If the DataAgent does not exist, a 404 error is returned
v1_parameters.help_zh: 要删除的 DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入。DataAgent 不存在时返回 404
v1_parameters.name: name
